name: staged_push_top
author: both
summary: The staged push: 5 push the top lane in stages while 3 cover the rear. ACCEPTED RISKS (named): the bottom is deliberately naked — the rear trades space for time (delay, then fall back behind the lineup wall) and we bet on winning the top race first; after phase 2 the rear is beyond shout range and fights autonomously.

phases.name: form_up
phases.intent: Pushers assemble in the top rally box; rear takes the lineup strip behind them covering the mid and bottom approaches (we are deliberately weak bottom — the rear's job is early warning + delay, not winning that fight).

enemy_belief.note: assume an even spread at start

phases.name: advance_to_midfield
phases.intent: Pushers advance as one 5-stack to the top-lane midfield (top_diamond / north_medkit shelf). Rear steps up to the vacated rally box — staying within shout range (~247px) of the pushers so the stage signal is heard.

entry.prose: pushers assembled at the rally (or timeout)

phases.name: break_or_flank
phases.intent: If the lane is lightly held, push straight through toward the pedestal. If we meet a concentrated defense (3+ tracked in the corridor ahead), split and pincer IN SEQUENCE: flank_s takes the inside shelf first and FIXES them (they have targets, they engage); only once flank_s has contact does flank_n sweep the top sneak line — hugging the wall through the sneak corridor — to arrive behind blue_top_hold_2 while the defense is busy frontally.

entry.prose: contact at midfield, or the corridor reads clear

notes.text: The split is the granularity demo: pushers exists until this phase splits it; flank_n/flank_s inherit and can split further. If the corridor is clear, skip the split — that branch needs its own phase or a condition vocabulary we don't have yet. Flagging rather than hiding it.
Rear plays a DELAYING ACTION: if they see an enemy push (watching rally_mid and the bottom), they run toward it and fight to slow it down, not to win it — buy the flankers time.

Adopted your retargets: flank_n sweeps wide to (802,27) — deeper than top_sneak, behind blue_top_hold_2; flank_s cuts to (654,206) — top_diamond shelf, pinching the corridor from the inside instead of holding back at our vee. Rear anchors at (323,333) with eyes mid + bottom. Phase 4 kept.

Issue-2 fix applied: flank_n now routes via the sneak corridor (566,20)->(700,20), wall-hugging, and the intent sequences it AFTER flank_s makes contact — the fixing attack covers the sweep. Also recorded the phase-3 comms reality: rear is out of shout range from here on; the rear fights autonomously (accepted).

Rear doctrine (from James): delay forward first; if mid/bottom pressure looks like a PUSH (multiple tracked), fall back behind the lineup wall and defend from cover — holding 3-4 of theirs while the flanks catch the rest is the win condition for this phase. Encoded as fallback:red_lineup on the rear hold order (schema addition: a hold may carry a fallback location).

phases.name: steal_and_convert
phases.intent: Merged pushers take the pedestal; fastest grabs, rest escort home along the top. Rear holds the lineup as the carrier's safety corridor. If the scoreboard says wipe-in-reach instead, everyone converts to the hunt (the standing convert trigger overrides this plan).
